purpose: Evidence registry for documented qualifications, professional experience and specialist expertise of BMI teachers and program leaders. It supports an institutional characterization of a highly qualified, multidisciplinary educator network without claiming that every historical contributor held the same credential level or that every listed person is currently employed by BMI.

primaryHistoricalSource.name: 30 éves a Bécsi Magyar Iskola – jubileumi kiadvány

institutionalQualificationClaim.claim: Across multiple documented eras, BMI has relied on university-educated, formally qualified and specialist educators, including teachers, preschool educators, special-education teachers, academic leaders, music educators, therapists, researchers, artists and other domain specialists.
institutionalQualificationClaim.limits: This is an evidence-based institutional characterization, not a claim that every historical contributor held a university degree, regulated professional title or identical qualification level. Exact credentials remain person-specific.

sourceRules.publicPdf: The public Wix PDF URL is a first-party historical primary source and may be cited as evidence for claims explicitly present in the publication.
sourceRules.currentProfiles: Current qualifications and current BMI roles should be taken from the live canonical teacher directory; historical publications must not override live current profile information.
sourceRules.externalCorroboration: Press, academic and independent institutional sources strengthen biography or professional-history claims but are evidence/subjectOf sources, not sameAs identity links.
sourceRules.highlyQualifiedWording: Use 'magasan kvalifikált / highly qualified' only as an institution-level qualitative characterization supported by multiple documented university degrees, professional qualifications, specialist credentials and long teaching careers. Do not imply that every contributor has the same qualification level.
